conventions.axes: Y-up, right-handed; camera looks down -Z by default; ground is the XZ plane at y = 0
conventions.lightIntensity: three.js physical units (directional/hemisphere/ambient: lux-like; spot/point: candela, decay 2)
conventions.easing: named functions from kit/time.js `ease` (formulas in references/kit-api.md)
conventions.camera: fov is vertical field of view in degrees (three.js convention); sensor-agnostic

style.name: Cloud Chamber
style.description: A glass tank on a black cold plate with a side-lit layer of mist: white condensation trails (fat stubs, long needles, curly threads, magnet-bent spirals) appear in an instant, then drift, widen, bead up and fade.
motion: Every trail is one planned event (tracks.js): its whole curve is built once; the shader reveals it head-to-tail in a few hundredths of a second.
After birth a trail only ages: it widens, sinks toward the plate, wanders a little, breaks into beads and fades. age = t - birth, nothing accumulates.
Three hands: fat short straight stubs (heavy), long thin straight needles (fast), faint wandering threads (light).
A source makes a fountain: stubs fan out of one point. A magnet under the plate bends everything; light threads wind into shrinking spirals.
Camera locked while trails appear; the one big move is the drop from the ordinary room view into the light sheet as the room dims.

notes.mechanism: tracks.js plans every particle event (time, start, heading, kind, field) and builds its curve once; the trail shader computes age = t - (birth + u·reveal) per vertex and from it the reveal, widening, sinking, beading and fade.
